purpose: Export the already-derived F1 B16 CP5 and SWA345 endpoints to exact 457-group FP32 evaluation predictions; no training command is included.

source.execution_boundary: The predictor imports helper symbols from scripts/train_rnn.py, whose main is guarded. Generated bundle specs whitelist predict_run.py, the required runtime and src/wnn modules, and exclude every scripts/kaggle_h512_f1_* fit worker and the original fit spec. Both argv vectors execute scripts/predict_run.py only.

recovery_evidence.initialization_limitation: The pinned B16 trainer did not emit the initialization tensor digest. The source recovery receipt preserves it as unavailable and makes no reconstructed-as-observed claim.
recovery_evidence.recovery_scope: Verify and stage selected checkpoints and provenance only. CP3/CP4 and history remain in the local recovery archive; the derivation receipt and original collection manifest bind their hashes.

inputs.raw_data_policy: Mount the existing private raw dataset. The portable registry verifies byte identities inside each export; the runner checks mounted file sizes before launching.

timing_basis.limitations: The prior export times are local F0 full-valid observations, not Kaggle F1 measurements. The fixed per-worker cost deliberately charges both exports separately, including a full portable raw-input identity scan on each worker. The estimate supports bounded admission review; it is not a measured cloud runtime or a guarantee.

resource_deadlines.timeout_behavior: Existing kaggle_kernel and kaggle_gpu_runner enforce the outer monotonic deadline, per-worker cap, resource watchdog and finalization reserve. One T4 means the two fixed exports are queued serially; each is capped at 700 seconds and late work shrinks to remaining headroom. The generated kernel bootstrap's internal wall cap must be patched to 1700 seconds and recorded by KERNEL_DEADLINE_PATCH_R1.json before provider submission.

local_collection_and_grade.run_local_acceptance: Use research/campaign_2026-10-21/kaggle_h512_b16_offline_recovery_r1/accept_h512_f1_b16_offline.py on the downloaded predictions and local immutable checkpoints.
local_collection_and_grade.run_local_grade: Use research/campaign_2026-10-21/kaggle_h512_b16_offline_recovery_r1/grade_h512_f1_b16_offline.py, which calls the frozen R2 score_panel over the same five endpoints.
local_collection_and_grade.prediction_contract: 457 source-qualified groups, shape (457, 20000, 2), float32 C-contiguous NPY; local acceptance checks payload offset plus nbytes, finite values, sidecar/source/checkpoint identities and exact group order.
local_collection_and_grade.evidence_limit: F1 evaluation groups are exposed robustness evidence, not a fresh holdout or public-score forecast. The initial training tensor digest and post-fit training runtime-flag snapshot remain unavailable.

admission.quota_gate: Latest root observation was 2,345 seconds remaining at 2026-10-21 19:56 UTC with no other reservation. This is a planning floor only: refresh direct Kaggle quota and reservation state immediately before provider action, require at least 2,345 seconds and no other reservation, and stage a fresh cap receipt first.
admission.source_slug_note: The output dataset slug is a proposed unique ID only; root must confirm owner-scoped availability before using it.
